title: Scaling across depth, each step equally hard

design.question: Across depth, each step equally hard, how much money does each society need, and does the gap between traditional and OSO grow?
design.compare: 5 societies on 4 difficulties (depth 10, depth 20, depth 40, depth 80)
design.fixed: the simple model: 12 identical agents, equal money each round, a knowledge reward of 1 per new bit, no validation
design.measure: money needed to solve half the targets

answer: To solve half the targets, traditional needs 7.8× to 12.9× the money OSO needs. The gap grows with every step in difficulty.
caveats: Read off between the two budgets that bracket half the targets, in log budget.
Each difficulty has its own budget range; "> x" means not reached within it.
